integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically from the Bloch composition law, Schatten Hölder, the published qubit filter inequality, and a published sufficient entanglement-breaking criterion. The explicit nonunital witness is checked with exact arithmetic; no numerical sampling is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is sufficient only for non-entanglement-breaking qubit channels satisfying \(\|M\|_{\mathrm F}+\|c\|_2\le1\). It does not characterize the complementary region or settle filtered indices above two.
title: A nonunital Frobenius region where arbitrary qubit filters cannot delay entanglement breaking
